none: PAS ESS-88A10F: Roman Republican Denarius of Acilius Glabrio
contea di ritrovamento: Essex (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver republican denarius of the moneyer Mn. Acilius Glabrio, struck c. 49 BC (Reece period 1) and minted at Rome. Crawford 442/1a. Obverse: Laureate head of Salus facing right, with inscription behind: SALVTIS. All inside a border of dots. Reverse: Salus (Valetudo) standing left, leaning on column and holding snake in hand.
